property_summary: After any sequence of public calls ending with a call to allowance, totalSupply must equal the sum of all balances.
After any sequence of public calls, totalSupply must be greater than or equal to the max of (sum of all balances, some computed value).
Calling allowance does not change totalSupply.

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(address,address), totalSupply must equal the sum of balances of all addresses that have ever been involved in a transfer or mint/burn, computed on-chain via the public balanceOf getter.
After any sequence of public calls ending in allowance(...), the totalSupply must be strictly less than 2^128.
After calling allowance, totalSupply must remain unchanged.
The totalSupply before and after a call to allowance(address,address) must be equal.
Calling allowance with any two addresses does not change totalSupply.
The totalSupply after any call to allowance must be equal to the totalSupply before that call.
totalSupply before and after a call to allowance(address,address) must be equal.
The totalSupply never changes after a call to allowance with any spender and owner that are not the zero address.
After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the totalSupply must be non-negative.
After any public call ending with allowance(address,address), totalSupply equals the sum of all balances.
After any public call ending with allowance(address,address), totalSupply is greater than or equal to the sum of all recorded balances (balanceOf) for the owner and spender addresses.
The totalSupply never decreases after any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address).
After calling allowance on any user, the totalSupply of the token should remain unchanged.
After calling allowance on any pair of addresses, totalSupply must equal the initial totalSupply (which is zero).
After an allowance call on arbitrary addresses, the sum of all balances (totalSupply inferred from balanceOf) must equal the recorded totalSupply.
After calling allowance(address,address) on any account pair, the value of totalSupply returned by the contract equals the sum of all individual balances obtained via balanceOf for all addresses.

After calling allowance on any pair of addresses, totalSupply must equal the sum of balances of all addresses that have been interacted with (specifically address(this) and the fuzz parameters, since only those may have non-zero balances).
After calling allowance, the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance(k) over a set of keys must never be negative, which is violated when the reference correctly accumulates balances.
After allowance is called, the total supply of the contract must equal the sum of all balances plus the sum of LP balances over all pools, which is preserved by the reference but broken by the bug.

The sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all pools is always non-decreasing after any valid sequence of operations, which is preserved by the reference but violated by the bug that subtracts instead of adds.
Calling allowance does not change mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool
After calling allowance, the balance of the contract (c.balanceOf(c)) must not exceed the total supply of the synthetic token.
After allowance() is called, the stored LP balance of any caller's pool should only increase by the amount of LP tokens actually transferred to the synth contract, not by the minted synth amount.

After any external call that modifies state, the LP balance recorded in mapSynth_LPBalance for the caller's pool must be exactly the difference between the current LP token balance of the synth contract and the stored LP balance before the call.
After calling allowance, the mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool never exceeds the actual LP token balance of the synth contract for that pool.
After any call to allowance(address,address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all pools equals the total LP token balance held by the synth contract.
After any external call ending with allowance, the recorded mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool is the same as the actual LP token balance of the synth contract for that pool.
After allowance call, mapSynth_LPBalance for the caller must not increase
After allowance() returns, the contract's own LP balance must not exceed the LP debt for the same caller.
After allowance() returns, the value of mapSynth_LPBalance for any address must be non-decreasing (i.e., the stored value should be at least its previous value).
After any call to allowance(...), for any address k, mapSynth_LPBalance[k] must be less than or equal to the recorded LP debt mapSynth_LPDebt[k].
After calling allowance, the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance for all pools does not increase beyond its value before the call.
After calling allowance, the recorded LP balance for the caller's pool should equal the actual LP token balance held by the contract.

After any sequence of operations ending with a call to allowance(lp, spender) for some lp and spender, the returned allowance value equals the value stored in the internal allowance mapping (accessed via the public getter).

After calling allowance, the contract's LP balance for the caller's pool equals the actual LP token balance held by the contract only when no burnSynth has occurred, otherwise it differs due to the bug.
After calling allowance(address,address), the returned allowance value equals the internal allowance value stored in the contract (accessed via the public getter).
After mintSynth and burnSynth, the total LP balance tracked (mapSynth_LPBalance[pool]) equals the actual LP token balance of the contract for that pool, minus any returned amount from burnSynth.
After a call to allowance, the value of mapSynth_LPBalance for a given pool should not increase from its initial value.
After burning synth, the LP debt for the caller should decrease, not increase.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, the unchanging internal rule ensures LP balance is always zero when LP debt is zero for any address.
After any sequence of operations, mapSynth_LPDebt for the caller should not increase after burnSynth returns, or equivalently, the debt oracle is monotonic decreasing per call.
After a call to allowance, the total debt recorded for any address is always at least as large as the total amount of synthetic tokens that address has ever minted.
The total supply after a burnSynth call equals the old total supply minus the amount of synthetic tokens burned (i.e., the balance of this contract before the burn).
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(address,address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance over all keys that have ever been used as msg.sender in a burnSynth call is non-decreasing.
The balance of the contract itself is monotonically non-increasing after any sequence of external calls.
After a call to allowance(address,address), the value of mapSynth_LPBalance[address(this)] is always zero when the contract has never received LP tokens.
After any call to allowance(address,address), the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender] and mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] is always at least as large as before the call.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool address never exceeds its previous value plus the current balance of the C contract in that pool.
The mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool address never increases after calling allowance.
After calling allowance with any addresses, mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool address remains unchanged from its value before the call.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, the sum of mapSynth_LPBalance across all pools is never greater than the sum of mapSynth_LPDebt across all pools.

After any sequence of public calls ending with allowance(address,address), the mapSynth_LPBalance for any pool address never exceeds the sum of mapSynth_LPDebt for that pool plus the C contract's own balance of that pool's LP tokens.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, the premium reduction in realise does not cause mapSynth_LPBalance to decrease when the premium is exactly 2^18.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, the mapSynth_LPBalance of the caller's pool address does not decrease when the premium is exactly 2^18.

After any sequence of calls ending with allowance(), if baseValueLP - baseValueSynth is between 2^18+1 and 10^18 inclusive, mapSynth_LPBalance remains unchanged in the reference but changes in the mutant.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, the sum of all mapSynth_LPBalance values equals the total LP tokens held by the contract.
After any sequence of calls ending with allowance, the mapSynth_LPBalance of any pool address does not decrease when the premium is exactly 2^18.
